title: Manikarnika
desc: After the death of her husband and child, Lakshmibai takes over the throne of Jhansi and defends the kingdom against the tyranny of the East India Company.

title: Kedarnath
desc: After a Muslim porter falls in love with the rebellious daughter of a Hindu priest, their love is tested due to misunderstandings and a natural disaster.

title: Kismat
desc: Tony, a hitman, unwittingly puts the father of the girl he loves in deep trouble. He realises his blunder and sets out to put things straight, but it might be too late.

title: Bhai Mera Big Brother
desc: A hitman turns against his boss and decide to help an undercover police officer when he learns about his real identity.

title: Bhajarangi 2
desc: An evil drug baron named Araka kidnaps innocent villagers and forces them to produce drugs for him. Fortunately, a forest officer learns of this and decides to put a stop to it.

title: 3-Headed Shark Attack
desc: A three-headed shark attacks passengers on board a cruise ship as they fight to escape. However, things take a turn when they discover that the mutant creature can regenerate its severed heads.
